A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. A Dictionary of Urdu, Classical Hindi, and English. Search for headword: 'ṭhe' 31 results Highlight text and press "t" to transliterate (devanagari script only) 1) تهيگلي theglī
                        ( p. 350 ) H تهيگلي थेगली theglī [S. स्थग + lī = Prk. अडिआ S. र + इका ], s.f. A patch, a piece (in a garment, &c. syn. paiwand ): — theglī lagānā (- meṅ ), To put a patch (in), to patch. 2) تهينورا theṅwarā, theṅwrā
                        ( p. 350 ) H تهينورا थेंवरा theṅwarā , theṅwrā [S. स्तरिमा + र + कः ], s.m. Bed (of a garden); border. 3) تهيوا thewā
                        ( p. 350 ) H تهيوا थेवा thewā [S. स्तरिमा ], s.m. Setting (of a stone); stone set in a ring. 4) تهيي تهيي theʼī-theʼī, thai-thai
                        ( p. 350 ) H تهيي تهيي थेईथेई theʼī-theʼī , थैथै thai-thai (Prākrit थैथै ), s.f. Merry-making, tumultuous mirth; music and singing, song and dance; beating time with the foot; — adv. With noisy mirth, merrily, noisily: — theʼī-theʼī karnā , v.n. To make merry, to rejoice, to caper, &c. 5) ٿهيبا ṭhebā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيبا ठेबा ṭhebā , s.m. (prov.) = ṭhewā . 6) ٿهيپي ṭhepī
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيپي ठेपी ṭhepī [S. स्तम्भिका ], s.f. Stopple, stopper, plug, cork, bung: — ṭhepī-dār , adj. Stopped with a plug, having a stopper or plug or cork, corked: — ṭhepī muṅh-meṅ denā ( kisī-ke ), To stop the mouth (of anyone), to silence, to gag; to stop (one's own, - apne ) mouth, to be silent. 7) ٿهيٿهہ ṭheṭh
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيٿهہ ठेठ ṭheṭh [S. तथ्यः ], adj. Pure, genuine; real, true, actual, very; good, sound; chaste, idiomatic (as language); — contentious. 8) ٿهيس ṭhes
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيس ठेस ṭhes (cf. ṭhos , ṭhās , ṭhas ), s.f. Knock, blow; thrust, push, shove; striking the foot (against an obstacle), tripping (against); — ṭhes lagnā , v.n. To be knocked (against), to receive a knock, &c. to trip (against = ṭhokar lagnā ). 9) ٿهيسرا ṭhesrā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيسرا ठेसरा ṭhesrā [ ṭhes + rā = Prk. अडओ = S. र + कः ], s.m. Jeer, taunt, sneer, indirect reflection, innuendo. 10) ٿهيسنا ṭhesnā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيسنا ठेसना ṭhesnā (i.q. ṭhāṅsnā ), v.t. To thrust, to pierce; to knock, push, shove; to strike against; to thrust or ram in, to cram, stuff; to eat voraciously ( = ṭhosnā ). 11) ٿهيك ṭhek
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيك ठेक ṭhek [S. स्थम्भ + इका ; but cf. ṭek ], s.f. A support, a prop; a ledge or platform (on which a porter rests his load); a station (for pālkī -bearers, carts, &c., syn. aḍḍā ); a wedge; bottom; the heel of a shoe; a shock of unthreshed corn; a large sack filled with grain, a load. 12) ٿهيکا ṭhekā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيکا ठेका ṭhekā , s.m. A plug, a stopple, a cork ( = ṭhepī ; ṭhekī ). 13) ٿهيکن ṭhekan
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيکن ठेकन ṭhekan , s.f. Prop, &c. ( = ṭhek ; ṭek ; ṭekan ). 14) ٿهيکنا ṭheknā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيکنا ठेकना ṭheknā (see ṭhek ), v.n. To strike or knock (against), come into collision (with); to touch the bottom, to ground, to stick (as a boat). 15) ٿهيکي ṭhekī
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيکي ठेकी ṭhekī (see ṭhek ), s.f. The act of resting on the way (by a porter carrying a load); a resting place (as for a porter carrying a load); prop, support ( = ṭhek ); a large sack of grain, a load; a plug, cork ( = ṭhepī ; ṭheṅṭhī ): — ṭhekī denā , v.t. To rest (against, as one carrying a load). 16) ٿهيگا ṭhegā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيگا ठेगा ṭhegā , s.m. (In gram.) An enclitic word 17) ٿهيل ṭhel
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيل ठेल ṭhel = H ٿهيلا ठेला ṭhelā (v.n. fr. ṭhel-nā ), s.m. Push, shove, thrust, impulse; — ṭhelā , A truck; a trolly; a wheel-barrow: — ṭhel-ans , s.m. A share or portion of land acquired by force: — ṭhelā-ṭhelī , ṭhelam-ṭhel , s.f. Shoving and shouldering, pushing, jostling: — ṭhelā-gāṛī , s.f. A truck, &c. = ṭhelā . 18) ٿهيلا ṭhelā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيلا ठेला ṭhelā = H ٿهيل ठेल ṭhel (v.n. fr. ṭhel-nā ), s.m. Push, shove, thrust, impulse; — ṭhelā , A truck; a trolly; a wheel-barrow: — ṭhel-ans , s.m. A share or portion of land acquired by force: — ṭhelā-ṭhelī , ṭhelam-ṭhel , s.f. Shoving and shouldering, pushing, jostling: — ṭhelā-gāṛī , s.f. A truck, &c. = ṭhelā . 19) ٿهيلنا ṭhelnā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيلنا ठेलना ṭhelnā [ ṭhel˚ = S. स्थालय ( ति ), caus. of rt. स्थल् ], v.t. To push, shove, shoulder, jostle; to move forward by pushing, to propel. 20) ٿهيلنا ṭhelnā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيلنا ठेलना ṭhelnā , s.m. Acting the buffoon. 21) ٿهينٿهہ ṭheṅṭh
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينٿهہ ठेंठ ṭheṅṭh , adj. = ṭheṭh , q.v. 22) ٿهينٿهي ṭheṅṭhī
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينٿهي ठेंठी ṭheṅṭhī , s.f. A plug, cork, bung ( = ṭhepī ; ṭhekī ); a lurap or ball of ear-wax; a dhotī or cloth reaching as far as the knee. 23) ٿهين ٿهين ṭheṅ-ṭheṅ
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهين ٿهين ठेंठें ṭheṅ-ṭheṅ [S. स्त्यानं redupl.; or onomat.], s.f. Silly and noisy laughter, giggle ( = ṭhī-ṭhī ); cf. ṭeṅ-ṭeṅ . 24) ٿهينٿي ṭheṅṭī
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينٿي ठेंटी ṭheṅṭī , s.f. = ṭheṅṭhī , q.v. 25) ٿهينسنا ṭheṅsnā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينسنا ठेंसना ṭheṅsnā , v.t. = ṭhesnā , q.v. 26) ٿهينگا ṭheṅgā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينگا ठेंगा ṭheṅgā [S. अति + घ्न + कः ], s.m. A bludgeon, a small club, a cudgel, a stick; — the thumb ( = ṭhosā ); the penis: — ṭheṅgā bājnā , v.n. Cudgel to sound, stick to be used; to have a row, to fall out, to use clubs; — to be called a penis, to be called an opprobrious name, to be disgraced, to be jeered or hooted. 27) ٿهينگنا ṭheṅgnā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينگنا ठेंगना ṭheṅgnā [ ṭheṅg ( ā )+ nā = lā = Prk. अडओ = S. ल + कः ], adj. Stumpy, short, &c. = ṭhingnā , q.v. 28) ٿهينگيل ṭheṅgail
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهينگيل ठेंगैल ṭheṅgail [ ṭheṅgā , q.v.+Prk. इल्लो = S. इलः ], s.m. A cudgeller. 29) ٿهيونا ṭheṅwnā, ṭheṅʼonā, ṭheṅʼunā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيونا ठेंवना ṭheṅwnā , ṭheṅʼonā , ठेंउना ṭheṅʼunā , s.m. = ṭheʼonā , q.v. 30) ٿهيوا ṭhewā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيوا ठेवा ṭhewā [S. स्तरिम , rt. स्तृ ], s.m. The place for a stone in a ring ( = thewā ). 31) ٿهيونا ṭhewnā, ṭheʼonā, ṭheʼunā
                        ( p. 366 ) H ٿهيونا ठेवना ṭhewnā , ṭheʼonā , ठेउना ṭheʼunā [S. अष्ठीवान् ], s.m. The knee; the pastern (of a horse). Search Form • DDSA Close
